Welcome to the tutorial pages for **MECH 501/600 — Computational Turbulence**.

Each tutorial walks you through a hands-on exercise combining theory,
OpenFOAM simulations, and Python post-processing. Tutorials contain
numbered **Tasks** — complete them and upload your answers to
[Crowdmark](https://crowdmark.com) by the posted deadline.

## How to work through a tutorial

1. Read the background section and run the provided code yourself.
2. Answer all Task boxes (derivations, plots, short discussions).
3. Export your answers as a single PDF and upload to Crowdmark.

## Tutorials

| # | Topic | Crowdmark due date |

| 1 | [The law of the wall & channel flow post-processing](tutorials/tutorial-01.qmd) | TBD |

## Software you will need

- **Python** ≥ 3.10 with `numpy`, `matplotlib` (and later `pyvista`/`fluidfoam`)
- **OpenFOAM** (introduced from Tutorial 2 onward)
- Access to the course cluster account (details in Tutorial 1)
